meta-huntsville-al.name: Meta Huntsville Data Center Campus
meta-huntsville-al.source: Meta's Huntsville, Alabama, data center expansion next to be stopped amid AI pivot
meta-huntsville-al.notes: Address: 5400 Prosperity Dr NW, Huntsville, AL. Coordinates are approximate for Cummings Research Park area. Original 2.5M sq ft campus operational; expansion to 3.5M sq ft paused December 2022 for AI architecture redesign; Meta stated no intent to abandon site. Over 85 grants and $4.2M in sponsorships to Huntsville-area schools since 2019. Meta's stated investment rose to more than $1.5B with the June 2022 expansion (original 2018 build ~$750M); the 3.5M-sq-ft expansion was later paused for AI redesign, so the ultimately realized figure is uncertain. Alabama's standard data-center abatement (Chapter 9B) likely applies, but no dollar figure was found in public sources.

tierpoint-little-rock-ar.name: TierPoint Little Rock
tierpoint-little-rock-ar.notes: Confirmed directly on TierPoint's own facility page (Arkansas - Little Rock).

arizona-land-consulting-hassayampa-ranch.name: Hassayampa Ranch Data Center
arizona-land-consulting-hassayampa-ranch.notes: ~$25B proposed data center campus led by Arizona Land Consulting (Anita Verma-Lallian) with investor Chamath Palihapitiya, on ~2,000 acres of far-western Maricopa County near Tonopah (acquired in a ~$51M deal). Maricopa County approved industrial rezoning Dec 10, 2025; zoning applications pending. Coordinates are an approximate town-level geocode near Tonopah, not a parcel-confirmed point.

fremont-peak-luckett-road-marana-az.name: Luckett Road Data Centers (Fremont Peak Properties)
fremont-peak-luckett-road-marana-az.utility: Trico Electric Cooperative (north parcel); Tucson Electric Power (south parcel)
fremont-peak-luckett-road-marana-az.water_notes: Marana town code prohibits use of potable water for cooling systems; project proposed as air-cooled. Additional water for irrigation/industrial/fire suppression to be provided by the Cortaro Marana Irrigation District.
fremont-peak-luckett-road-marana-az.source: Rezoning approved for Marana data center campus
fremont-peak-luckett-road-marana-az.notes: Two parcels along Luckett Road: north parcel owned by the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (borders Pinal County); south parcel owned by the Kai Family Trust. Fremont Peak Properties LLC (also referenced as 'Humphrey's Peak Properties' in some coverage) is a subsidiary of Beale Infrastructure, backed by Blue Owl Capital; connected to, but a distinct site from, the separately-tracked 'Project Blue' Beale/Blue Owl effort in unincorporated Pima County near Tucson, and from Beale's separately-tracked Project Pilot in De Soto, KS. Developer projects ~400 permanent and ~4,200 temporary construction jobs (Chamber of Southern Arizona estimate) - not yet delivered, so omitted from the jobs field. No explicit AI/GPU branding found in coverage; classified 'likely' given Blue Owl Capital's profile as a major AI-datacenter-era infrastructure investor. Coordinates are approximate for the Luckett Road parcels.

lumen-phoenix-1-az.name: Lumen Phoenix 1
lumen-phoenix-1-az.notes: OSM name was generic 'Lumen'; resolved to Phoenix 1 (811 S 16th St), the flagship legacy Level3 facility, as best match given single unnamed candidate in this city.

microsoft-el-mirage-az.name: Microsoft El Mirage Data Center Campus
microsoft-el-mirage-az.water_notes: Microsoft's Arizona datacenters use adiabatic cooling - zero water for cooling more than half the year (outside air below 85F), switching to evaporative ('swamp-cooler'-style) above 85F; Microsoft and Gila River Water Storage replenish Phoenix-AMA groundwater with long-term storage credits dedicated to El Mirage and Goodyear. No El Mirage-specific water-use (MGD) figure is published.
microsoft-el-mirage-az.source: Microsoft Data Center Planned in El Mirage — PHX-83 fifth building
microsoft-el-mirage-az.notes: investmentUsd is land-purchase cost only; total campus investment is higher. PHX-83 is the fifth building on existing El Mirage campus. Coordinates are El Mirage city centroid; site is at SE corner of Dysart Rd and Olive Ave. Arizona's Sec. 41-1519 sales/use-tax exemption applies by statute but no campus-specific certified award was found; published job figures cover the combined West Valley (El Mirage/Goodyear) campus, not El Mirage alone.

stream-data-centers-phxa-phoenix-i-vii-g.name: Stream Data Centers PHXA (Phoenix I-VII, Goodyear Campus)
stream-data-centers-phxa-phoenix-i-vii-g.source: Stream Data Centers - Phoenix/Goodyear locations page
stream-data-centers-phxa-phoenix-i-vii-g.notes: Operator's own Phoenix page names this campus 'PHXA (Phoenix I-VII)' at 2950 S. Litchfield Road, Goodyear, AZ 85338, Maricopa County. 157-acre, 7-building planned campus; 2 of 7 buildings currently operational, remaining 5 under development, so campus-level status is mixed-build but the entity is live/operational overall. Site markets '100% AI-ready infrastructure' but no confirmed GPU/HPC tenant or workload was found, so aiClassification is left empty rather than 'likely' -- marketing language alone is not workload evidence. Note officialName differs from OSM tag 'PHX-1'; corrected to operator's own 'PHXA'. AI/HPC (likely): Stream's own Phoenix/Goodyear campus page carries a facility-specific '100% AI-Ready' key-stat badge alongside its 280 MW critical capacity.

amazon-gilroy-ca.name: Amazon AWS Gilroy Data Center
amazon-gilroy-ca.water_notes: Final EIR-certified use is 23 acre-feet/year total (~7.49 million gallons/yr) at full build-out — 18 AFY for cooling (~0.016 MGD), 3 AFY landscaping, 2 AFY domestic (FEIR p.186); drawn from Gilroy potable supply pending a recycled-water pipeline. Evaporative cooling is triggered only when outdoor temperature exceeds 83F (~3% of the year). Amazon's promotional figure of ~4 million gallons/yr (~36 households) is roughly half the FEIR-certified total and is disputed in a CEQA challenge; Amazon says it aims for 100% reclaimed cooling water by 2030.
amazon-gilroy-ca.source: Amazon Data Services Gains Approval for Data Center on 56 Acres in Gilroy, California
amazon-gilroy-ca.notes: Status updated to under_construction: grading permit issued December 11, 2025; building permit issued March 19, 2026; City of Gilroy lists project as Under Construction as of July 2026. Site at 8050 Camino Arroyo in east Gilroy along Hwy 101. Full build-out: 438,000 sq ft across 56 acres. Amazon cites a ~$2 billion investment for the Gilroy project (recorded as investmentUsd); its broader Northern California investment of ~$5.1B and ~1,890 jobs since 2009 is regional and not attributable to this site. The 2020 land purchase was $31.3M. Operational job figures conflict and are unconfirmed: the FEIR says employment 'may grow to 50 full-time employees' (a ceiling), the permit application lists 25, and Amazon's promotional materials cite ~90 on-site; the construction workforce is not disclosed.

coresite-bowers-santa-clara-ca.notes: Coordinates approximate based on 2805 Bowers Ave address. qts-aurora-co.utility: Xcel Energy (Public Service Company of Colorado)
qts-aurora-co.water_notes: Colorado data center water use under scrutiny; Xcel projects data center load growth requiring $22B infrastructure spend by 2040
qts-aurora-co.source: QTS plans Denver build-out at 177MW Aurora campus
qts-aurora-co.notes: 1160 N. Gun Club Rd, Aurora, CO 80018; eastern Aurora near E-470. Former JPMorgan data center site. Four-building campus on 67 acres. Colorado's first hyperscale facility at this scale. Coordinates based on Gun Club Rd address. Investment amount and specific job counts (previously $1B, 500 construction, 77 permanent) removed — not confirmed by cited sources.

iron-mountain-mia-1-miami-fl.name: Iron Mountain MIA-1
iron-mountain-mia-1-miami-fl.source: Iron Mountain breaks ground on first data center in Miami
iron-mountain-mia-1-miami-fl.notes: 150,000 sq ft. Classified a "telecom hub" rather than "data center" under Miami-Dade county code. Opens 2026.

dcblox-atlanta-east-conyers-ga.name: DC BLOX Atlanta East Hyperscale Data Center Campus
dcblox-atlanta-east-conyers-ga.water_notes: High-efficiency magnetic bearing air-cooled chillers with thermal storage; N+2 chiller redundancy; N+5 vertical fan coolers; provisions for future liquid cooling tie-ins. EPD permit SAS-2024-00075 covers permanent impact of 0.213 acres wetlands, 3.30 acres pond, and over 1,200 linear feet of streams in Yellow River watershed; developer to purchase mitigation credits.
dcblox-atlanta-east-conyers-ga.source: DC BLOX announces Rockdale County hyperscale campus (Dec 12 2023)
dcblox-atlanta-east-conyers-ga.notes: Coordinates approximate; physical address is 1726 Farmer Road NW, Conyers GA 30012. Land: 72 acres acquired per press release; Georgia EPD permit SAS-2024-00075 references 52.84-acre development footprint with three 40MW buildings. Capacity: 216MW total committed by Georgia Power per utility agreement and DRI filing; DC BLOX facility page cites 154 critical/IT MW (1 × 10MW + 3 × 48MW buildings = 154MW IT load). Phase 1 targeted Q4 2025 delivery (hyperscale anchor + 160,000 sq ft available to additional tenants); non-water-quality construction began December 2025; water-quality permitted work may begin October 2026 with full build taking ~1 year. Dark fiber metro ring planned around Atlanta connecting Atlanta East and Atlanta West campuses and continuing to Myrtle Beach cable landing station. AI/ML applications explicitly cited in press materials as key driver of Atlanta hyperscale demand. DISTINCT from DC BLOX Atlanta West campus in Douglas County (Lithia Springs, ~55 acres, 180MW). Investment amount not publicly disclosed. Job counts not disclosed.

microsoft-tyrone-ga.name: Microsoft Tyrone Campus (Project Rita)
microsoft-tyrone-ga.water_notes: Source: Fayette County Water System. Microsoft estimates ~4,000 gallons/day operational.
microsoft-tyrone-ga.source: Microsoft confirms plans for data center in Tyrone, Georgia
microsoft-tyrone-ga.notes: Two-building campus (two 48 MW buildings = 96 MW, ~490,000-500,000 sq ft) plus an on-site substation; codename Project Rita. Part of Microsoft's East US 3 Azure region (planned 2027). Total site ~161 acres (~146.4 in Tyrone + ~14.5 in Fairburn). As of June 2 2026 no site plan or building permits filed. Microsoft requested no tax abatements (none offered). No investment figure disclosed. Coordinates approximate (address-derived; 2044 GA-74). Estimated ~4,000 gallons/day operational water use.

prologis-project-sail-coweta-ga.name: Project Sail – Prologis Data Center Campus
prologis-project-sail-coweta-ga.water_notes: Expected to use 6 million gallons of water per day drawn from the Chattahoochee River
prologis-project-sail-coweta-ga.source: $17B Project Sail data center project approved south of Atlanta
prologis-project-sail-coweta-ga.notes: Nine buildings, 4.3 million sq ft. End tenant not publicly identified; project marketed to hyperscalers. Rezoning includes decommissioning and site restoration plan requirement if dormant over one year. Coordinates are Newnan city centroid; actual site is along US-27 southwest of Newnan. A developer-commissioned fiscal study modeled roughly $488M in county and school property-tax abatements over 18 years, but the Coweta County Development Authority reported no incentive negotiations had occurred as of January 2025; no confirmed incentive agreement or job count has been published.

qts-atlanta-1-atlanta-metro-dc1-ga.name: QTS Atlanta 1 (Atlanta-Metro DC1)
qts-atlanta-1-atlanta-metro-dc1-ga.notes: Confirmed 4-building mega campus at 1033 Jefferson St NW etc, Atlanta, GA. This is the primary Atlanta 1 campus entry; candidate 1007825570 (Atlanta DC2) is on the same campus, kept as a separate co-located building only because it's independently confirmed as a distinct 72MW building, not because it's a distinct campus.

servpac-mtp2-mililani-hi.name: Servpac MTP Building 2
servpac-mtp2-mililani-hi.water_notes: Closed-loop cooling systems eliminate freshwater consumption entirely.
servpac-mtp2-mililani-hi.source: Hawaii-Based Cloud Provider Servpac Expands Data Center
servpac-mtp2-mililani-hi.notes: Located in Mililani Technology Park, Central O'ahu, 10 miles inland and 850 feet above sea level, outside major flood, tsunami, and hurricane zones. Building 2 will approximately 10x the existing 1MW IT capacity of MTP Building 1 (Hawaii's only Uptime Institute Tier IV certified facility). Designed to withstand Category 5 hurricane-force winds. Primary use is enterprise colocation; no AI-specific tenant announced. DCD (February 2026) reports project is in design phase; 'broke ground' claim in original record is unsupported by the cited source. Hawaii's structural barriers (highest US electricity costs, limited grid capacity) make large-scale hyperscale AI builds unlikely; Servpac MTP2 is the only Hawaii project of note found.

aws-hobart-in.name: AWS Hobart Campus
aws-hobart-in.water_notes: Outside-air cooling ~98% of the year; water-based cooling on peak days (~2%); ~14 million gallons/year; ~80% more water-efficient than industry average.
aws-hobart-in.source: AWS data center coming to Hobart, Indiana
aws-hobart-in.notes: One of AWS's Northwest Indiana campuses (part of a $15B NW Indiana / 2.4 GW umbrella; distinct from aws-project-rainier-new-carlisle-in and the separate Wheatfield IN campus). CAPACITY OMITTED: the 2.4 GW figure is the NW Indiana total, not Hobart-specific. INVESTMENT OMITTED: $15B is the NW Indiana total, no Hobart-specific figure. Up to 25 buildings on 725+ acres ('Hobart Tech Park'); shell entities include Hobart Devco, Hobart Owner LLC, TUHAUS LLC/Wylie Capital. ~400 permanent jobs ($37-44/hr) are projections (in notes, not jobs). $47M upfront community payment is city revenue, not facility capex. Coordinates estimated from 61st Ave/Colorado St; verify via Lake County GIS. Active litigation: 'No Data Centers Hobart Indiana' sought a TRO on the fill permit (unresolved).

tierpoint-kansas-city-lenexa-ks.notes: Confirmed on TierPoint's own directory: Kansas - Kansas City - Lenexa, 14500 W 105th St, Lenexa KS.

liquidcool-loring-afb-me.notes: 115,000 sq ft leased within Green 4 Maine's 450-acre innovation hub on former USAF base. LiquidCool Solutions is a Minnesota-based technology company. First phase starts at 5-6MW; 50MW total available at base. Project marketed as cross-border US/Canada AI hub.

edgeconnex-det01-mi.notes: Confirmed via official page: facility code DET01, Tier 3 designed, ENERGY STAR certified, 39,900 sq ft (9,930 sq ft raised floor), operational.

vantage-nv1-storey-county-nv.water_notes: Closed-loop chiller system minimizing water use; campus targets industry-leading low Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE); LEED certification planned

vantage-nv1-storey-county-nv.notes: Located in Tahoe Reno Industrial Center (TRIC), Storey County, NV — same industrial park as Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Switch (CITADEL tracked separately). Four multi-story buildings, 1M+ sq ft. Designed for AI densities 360W–720W per sq ft. Vantage's eighth North American market. Coordinates are approximate TRIC centroid. Primary press release states more than 1,200 individuals employed 'across the construction and ongoing operations' — combined construction + permanent total; construction vs. permanent breakdown not separately disclosed.

bloomberg-orangeburg-ny.name: Bloomberg LP Data Center
bloomberg-orangeburg-ny.source: WFRBS Commercial Mortgage Trust 2014-C20 FWP (Bloomberg Orangeburg facility disclosure)
bloomberg-orangeburg-ny.notes: 155 Corporate Drive, Orangeburg, NY (Town of Orangetown, Rockland County). 131,805 sq ft total, two data halls totaling 39,058 sq ft with 42" raised floor and 26' clear height, 4.0 MW power system, 1,200-ton cooling capacity — all per an authoritative SEC EDGAR CMBS filing (2014). Construction cost was $123.2M ($935/sq ft) per that same filing, with Bloomberg contributing $39.0M toward construction; recorded here as investmentUsd rather than the frequently-cited $710M figure, which represents total lease payments over a 15-year term (expiring March 2029), not construction capital — those are not comparable numbers and conflating them would overstate the capital investment. Dedicated single-tenant enterprise facility built to Bloomberg's spec for its financial data/analytics terminals (not shared colocation), built/topped-off 2013-2014. No expansions since 2014 were found in this research pass, but absence of news is not proof of none. Coordinates are a town-level geocode, not a confirmed parcel pin.

riverview-innovation-tech-campus-tonawan.name: Riverview Innovation & Technology Campus
riverview-innovation-tech-campus-tonawan.powered_by: Grid (National Grid); Niagara Power Project + Nine Mile Point Nuclear Station upstream mix
riverview-innovation-tech-campus-tonawan.water_notes: Community opposition specifically cited cooling-system noise (24/7 operation, cited by residents as 75-105+ decibels) as a top concern at the June 3, 2026 Planning Board meeting; specific cooling technology not yet disclosed by the developer.
riverview-innovation-tech-campus-tonawan.nearest_nuclear_name: R E Ginna Nuclear Power Plant

Williams completed acquisition Oct. 10, 2019 and has led an estimated $100M remediation; Honeywell (successor to Allied Chemical/TCC predecessor) also involved. 500,000 sq ft facility proposed. Coordinates are approximate for the River Road parcel. aws-warner-road-jerome-township-oh.name: AWS Warner Road Campus (Jerome Township)
aws-warner-road-jerome-township-oh.powered_by: Amazon's Ohio wind/solar portfolio is company-wide clean-energy matching (23 wind/solar projects, incl. the Paulding County wind farm), not a site-specific PPA for this campus.
aws-warner-road-jerome-township-oh.source: Union County Auditor building record (parcel 1500300200000 / 8567 Warner Rd — Amazon Data Services Inc, year built 2023-2024, multiple buildings ~214k+214k+157k sq ft, $36.7M appraised building value, 92.8 ac)
aws-warner-road-jerome-township-oh.notes: Operational AWS data center on a ~93-acre Amazon Data Services Inc parcel at 8567 Warner Rd, Jerome Township / Plain City, Union County — part of Amazon's AWS US-East-2 (Ohio) Jerome Township / 'New California' cluster. Jerome Township Trustees rezoned 99.5 acres on the south side of Warner Rd (west of Industrial Pkwy) for an Amazon data center in Feb 2021. Union County Auditor building record: year built 2023-2024, multiple buildings (~214k + 214k + 157k sq ft assessed), $36.7M appraised building value. Sits ~2 km south of the Amazon Industrial Pkwy campus (tracked separately) and ~2 km north of the Amazon Crosby Ct campus across the line in Franklin County. No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed. Coordinates are the Union County Auditor parcel centroid.

edged-columbus-new-albany-oh.name: Edged Columbus
edged-columbus-new-albany-oh.source: Franklin County parcel/GIS record (parcel 222-002127 — EDGED COLUMBUS LLC, 7600 W Campus Blvd, use-class "data center")
edged-columbus-new-albany-oh.notes: Operational since its September 10-11, 2025 grand opening. 206,000 sq ft, two-story, 14-acre site with 24 MW of critical (IT) capacity per Edged's own release. Purpose-built for AI training and inference; supports up to 70 kW/rack air-cooled and 200 kW/rack liquid-cooled. Uses the ThermalWorks waterless cooling system (design PUE ~1.15).
